name: NOTTO (National Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation)
description: Apex government organization coordinating procurement, allocation, and registry of human organs and tissues under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
source: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India

name: e-RaktKosh Blood Portal
description: Centralized initiative by MoHFW connecting, digitizing, and streamlining blood donation workflows and real-time blood stock availability across Indian blood banks.
source: MoHFW & Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

name: National Blood Transfusion Council (NBTC)
description: Policy formulating apex body for blood transfusion services in India, ensuring voluntary, safe, and quality blood collection standards.

name: Indian Red Cross Society
description: Voluntary humanitarian organisation operating accredited blood banks, nationwide donation camps, and disaster relief services across India.
source: Indian Red Cross Society National Headquarters

name: MOHAN Foundation
description: Pioneering non-profit organization promoting deceased organ donation, transplant coordination training, and grief counseling for donor families.

name: Shatayu - Gift of Life
description: Public trust dedicated to increasing awareness about organ donation and honoring donor families across Western India.

name: OrganDonor.gov
description: Official U.S. Government information source for organ and tissue donation, state registries, and national transplant policies.
source: Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA), HHS

name: NHS Blood and Transplant
description: Special Health Authority managing the NHS Organ Donor Register, blood donation campaigns, and organ matching across the UK.
source: National Health Service (NHS) Blood and Transplant

name: DonateLife Australia
description: Australian Government agency leading the national program to optimize organ and tissue donation for transplantation across all states.

name: Canadian Blood Services
description: National non-profit charitable organisation managing blood, plasma, stem cells, and organ/tissue donation coordination across Canada (excl. Quebec).
